attributes.name: Fast track clearance with assistance at Hurghada Airport
attributes.description:
Get fast-track clearance through the arrival or departure hall and you'll be guaranteed a quick and hassle-free process through Hurghada Airport. A perfect choice for first-time travelers or families.

As soon as your plane lands, you'll be met by one of our courteous agents holding a welcome sign including your name in the arrival hall.

On your way back, you'll meet one of our courteous agents holding a welcome sign, including your name at the departure terminal gate with a porter assistant.
inclusions: Assistance with visa if required (visa fee excluded)
Stamp your passport with passport control.
Escort you to the gate of the arrival hall to meet your representative to get your transfer.
exclusions: Hotel pick up or drop off.
attributes.meeting_point: Hurghada International Airport arrival or departure hall.
things_to_remember: Your passport must be valid for a minimum of 6 months upon arrival, including children and infants.

Please confirm your travel date and flight details with our team including flight number, flight arrival time to Hurghada Airport, and take-off time on departure from Hurghada with the destination name.
If your nationality is German, French, Belgian, Portuguese, or Italian you can enter the country with your personal ID and a recent photo.
Rate is per passenger (adult, child or infant).
Rate is per arrival or departure service.
attributes.cancellation_policy: Receive a 100% refund if you cancel up to 24 hours before the experience begins.
attributes.info_voucher: If you have any additional questions, you can contact AL-GEWAR Travel Customer Care at +20 100 123 4567 or info@algewar.com
